Canon Beat: USJ climax clock.script: (function(){const B=[[5, "the Nomu overwhelms Shota Aizawa and pins him to the plaza; in the chaos Tenya Iida slips out through the doors to run for help"], [8, "All Might bursts through the USJ doors (\"I am here!\") and goes straight for the Nomu to free Aizawa and the students"], [12, "All Might drives the Nomu up through the dome roof into the sky; the clash ends there"], [15, "All Might's time runs out and he bluffs as Shigaraki advances; the faculty arrive with Iida, Snipe's shots stop Shigaraki, and Shigaraki and Kurogiri escape through the mist"]];const tk=check({type:'game-tick'})||0;if(typeof storage.usjT!=='number')storage.usjT=tk;const age=tk-storage.usjT;const b=B.filter(x=>age>=x[0]&&age<=x[0]+1)[0];if(!b){skip=true;return;}effects.push({type:'story',instruction:'Narrator only, USJ pacing (canon default, pressure the player can change): unless the story already went past this beat or the player changed it, this turn '+b[1]+'. Play it on screen; do not stall on the previous beat.'});log('usj beat '+b[0]+' age '+age);})();
